facts.fact: The Office of the Ombudsman of The Gambia launched a website that, for the first time, lets citizens file a complaint online; no case numbers are given.
NAWEC, the national water and electricity company, launched a mobile app on which customers can lodge complaints and report faults in real time with photos, though no complaint numbers are given.
